notes.title: Shadow Fight Arena
notes.content:
Hey all,

Our team is rather famous in the world of mobile games and we have been waiting for our moment to meet PC players. We are Banzai Games, the studio behind the Shadow Fight series. Last year we made a big step in the new era of the franchise by introducing real-time PvP mode. Now it is our time to make a Steam appearance. 

Shadow Fight represents our vision of the fighting games. We are driven by the following principles: a) we love great realistic animations and we want to share this love in our visual style and gameplay b) we want to make fighting games comfortable to play for as many players as possible c) we are fans of various cultures around the world and we want to integrate all their beauty into our universe d) we are making weapon-based fighting games, because it diversifies the gameplay and animations, and also allows us to bring something new to the genre. 

The story of Shadow Fight began 10 years ago when we made a fighting game with a rich RPG experience. We created an interesting world inspired by ninjas and samurai, we enhanced it with a range of different fighting styles which we could find in the real world. We are big fans of martial arts and weapons mastery and we want to demonstrate all their greatness to the world in a very entertaining manner. 10 years later we still provide the most unique fighting experience on mobile platforms and it’s mostly due to the devotion to our interests. 

We aim to bring this unique  fighting game experience to all kinds of players using all possible gaming platforms through our latest title Shadow Fight Arena. On our Steam page we will share our PC approach and introduce you to all ins and outs of the Shadow Fight universe. For those who are familiar with the series we will be revealing new and exciting details.  

Follow our community hub, leave the comments and share your questions, we will be keeping in touch!
